decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing builds directly on the firm’s existing drainage technology and customizable manufacturing, so it can assimilate early results and improve the product, making a drop unlikely.
As a floor-level shower drainage system, it is central to the firm’s established knowledge and direction, allowing effective learning and retention.
The designer shower drainage product aligns with the firm’s design-conscious, low-profile direction and leverages existing drainage expertise, so it is likely kept.
The shower element with integrated slope extends the firm’s installation and waterproofing know-how, and early mentions suggest ongoing integration with core products, so keep.

The backflow-protected basement floor drain applies proven drainage technology and patented installation features to a new application, and strong early presentation indicates the firm can interpret and build on results.
